org: Ilia State University (Centre for Personal and Professional Development, with the Faculty of Arts and Sciences and IliaUni Theatre)

name.en: The Art of Public Speaking and Communication: Certificate Course (Ilia State University)
name.ka: სასერტიფიკატო კურსი „საჯარო გამოსვლისა და კომუნიკაციის ხელოვნება“ (ილიაუნი)
name.ar: دورة شهادة «فن الخطابة والتواصل» في جامعة إيليا الحكومية

deadline_note: Application deadline 20 November 2026 stated on the university's announcement.

summary.en: A four-week certificate course on the stage of IliaUni Theatre in Tbilisi that trains public speaking, confidence and persuasive communication through psychology, body-based practice and drama. Apply by 20 November 2026.
summary.ka: ოთხკვირიანი სასერტიფიკატო კურსი ილიაუნის თეატრის სცენაზე, რომელიც ფსიქოლოგიის, სხეულზე ორიენტირებული პრაქტიკისა და დრამის მეშვეობით ავითარებს საჯარო გამოსვლისა და კომუნიკაციის უნარებს. განაცხადის ბოლო ვადაა 20 ნოემბერი, 2026.
summary.ar: دورة شهادة مدتها أربعة أسابيع على مسرح جامعة إيليا في تبليسي، تنمّي مهارات الخطابة والثقة بالنفس والتواصل المقنع عبر علم النفس والتمارين الجسدية والدراما. آخر موعد للتقديم 20 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
Ilia State University's Centre for Personal and Professional Development, together with the Faculty of Arts and Sciences and the IliaUni Theatre, runs a certificate course called 'The Art of Public Speaking and Communication'. The programme combines psychology, body-oriented practice and drama: participants work on the theatre stage to overcome speaking anxiety, build confidence, express ideas clearly and convincingly, and influence an audience.

The course is led by Saba Chikhladze (MA in organisational psychology) and runs for four weeks at the IliaUni Theatre in Tbilisi, with eight two-hour sessions between 24 November and 19 December 2026 (evening and Saturday afternoon slots). It suits university students, graduates and young professionals who want practical speaking skills for debate, MUN, interviews or presentations; teaching is in Georgian.

en: Practical public-speaking training on a real theatre stage
Combines psychology, body-based practice and drama techniques
Ilia State University certificate; fee can be paid in instalments

eligibility.en: Open to anyone interested (students, graduates, professionals); taught in Georgian, so participants need a working command of Georgian.

en: Read the announcement on the Ilia State University news page
Submit an application via the link or contact given in the announcement before 20 November 2026
Arrange payment of the course fee (instalments possible)
Attend the first session on 24 November 2026 at the IliaUni Theatre

costs.en: Fee: 600 GEL for the whole course (can be split into instalments).

score_reason: Useful practical skills course with a near deadline, but paid and Georgian-language only.

org: Ilia State University with the Lane Kirkland Scholarship Program alumni network

name.en: Kirkland Programme Day at Ilia State University 2026
name.ka: კირკლანდის პროგრამის დღე ილიას სახელმწიფო უნივერსიტეტში 2026
name.ar: يوم برنامج كيركلاند في جامعة إيليا الحكومية 2026

deadline_note: Free event on 4 November 2026; prior registration is required, so register by 3 November.

summary.en: A free in-person information day in Tbilisi about the Lane Kirkland Scholarship Program for study and research in Poland, with alumni talks, Q&A and networking. Register in advance for 4 November 2026.
summary.ka: უფასო საინფორმაციო დღე თბილისში ლეინ კირკლანდის სასტიპენდიო პროგრამის შესახებ (სწავლა და კვლევა პოლონეთში) — კურსდამთავრებულთა გამოცდილება, კითხვა-პასუხი და ნეთვორქინგი. საჭიროა წინასწარი რეგისტრაცია, 4 ნოემბერი, 2026.
summary.ar: يوم تعريفي مجاني حضوري في تبليسي حول منحة لين كيركلاند للدراسة والبحث في بولندا، مع لقاءات الخريجين وجلسة أسئلة وتواصل. التسجيل المسبق مطلوب ليوم 4 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
Ilia State University hosts a Kirkland Programme Day dedicated to the Lane Kirkland Scholarship Program, a Polish-funded programme that brings young professionals, graduates and researchers from Georgia and other partner countries to Polish universities for study, research and practical experience.

The event presents the programme's opportunities and application procedure, includes an interactive Q&A session and 'Kirkland Open Space', where participants meet alumni informally and discuss academic and professional plans. It is useful for students, graduates, young professionals and researchers considering study or research in Poland. Working language: English; in person on 4 November 2026, 10:00–14:00, Ilia State University hall G106 (Tsereteli Ave. 1-3, Tbilisi).

en: Meet Lane Kirkland alumni and ask about applying
Learn the application procedure for study and research in Poland
Free, in English, with networking in 'Kirkland Open Space'

eligibility.en: Open to students, graduates, young professionals, researchers and civil-society staff; English is the working language. Prior registration required.

en: Open the event announcement on the Ilia State University website
Fill in the registration form linked in the announcement
Attend on 4 November 2026 at 10:00 in hall G106, Ilia State University, Tbilisi

score_reason: Free and useful for those targeting the Kirkland scholarship, but a one-day info event.

org: Georgian, German and International Criminal Law Institute, The University of Georgia (UG)

name.en: Comparative Criminal Law: German and Georgian Perspectives (training for law students)
name.ka: ტრენინგი „შედარებითი სისხლის სამართალი – გერმანული და ქართული პერსპექტივები“ სამართლის სტუდენტებისთვის
name.ar: تدريب «القانون الجنائي المقارن: منظور ألماني وجورجي» لطلبة القانون

grades: university (2nd-year bachelor and above, master's, PhD)
deadline_note: CV and motivation letter due 15 November 2026 per UG announcement.

summary.en: A free, certificate-bearing training in Tbilisi on comparative German and Georgian criminal law, taught by professors from Cologne, Istanbul/Bochum and UG. Open to law students from any accredited Georgian university; apply by 15 November 2026.
summary.ka: უფასო სასერტიფიკატო ტრენინგი თბილისში გერმანული და ქართული სისხლის სამართლის შედარებით ანალიზზე — კიოლნის, სტამბოლის/ბოხუმისა და UG-ის პროფესორებთან. ღიაა საქართველოს ნებისმიერი აკრედიტებული უნივერსიტეტის სამართლის სტუდენტებისთვის; ვადა 15 ნოემბერი, 2026.
summary.ar: تدريب مجاني بشهادة في تبليسي حول القانون الجنائي الألماني والجورجي المقارن، يقدمه أساتذة من كولونيا وإسطنبول/بوخوم وجامعة جورجيا. مفتوح لطلبة القانون في أي جامعة جورجية معتمدة؛ التقديم حتى 15 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
The Georgian, German and International Criminal Law Institute of the University of Georgia (UG) runs a competitive call for a one-day training, 'Comparative Criminal Law – German and Georgian Perspectives'. It is taught by Professor Martin Wasmeier (University of Cologne), Associate Professor Özdem Özaydın (Istanbul Kültür University and Ruhr University Bochum) and Professor Bachana Jishkariani (UG).

The training takes place on 27 November 2026, 12:00–17:00, in the conference hall (room 519) of UG, 77a Kostava Street, Tbilisi. It is free; the working language is German with Georgian interpretation. Participants who attend the whole session receive a certificate. It is a good way for law students to meet German academics and explore criminal-law study or research in Germany.

en: Taught by professors from the University of Cologne, Ruhr University Bochum and UG
Free, with a certificate for full attendance
Open to law students from all accredited Georgian universities

eligibility.en: Law students from any accredited university in Georgia from the second year of bachelor's study, plus master's and PhD students; a limited number of practising lawyers. Georgian interpretation is provided, so German is not required.

en: Prepare a CV and a motivation letter
Email them to institute.criminallaw@gmail.com by 15 November 2026
Wait for confirmation of selection
Attend on 27 November 2026 at UG, 77a Kostava Street, room 519

score_reason: Free, open to law students nationwide, with international faculty; short one-day format.

org: TOLES Legal English Centre Georgia at The University of Georgia (UG)

name.en: Illuminate Plus: Practical Legal English Course (University of Georgia)
name.ka: Illuminate Plus — პრაქტიკული იურიდიული ინგლისურის კურსი (საქართველოს უნივერსიტეტი)
name.ar: Illuminate Plus: دورة الإنجليزية القانونية العملية (جامعة جورجيا)

deadline_note: Application deadline 8 November 2026 per UG announcement.

summary.en: A five-week practical Legal English course in Tbilisi based on the TOLES/Cambridge Law Studio curriculum, covering contracts and commercial law in 10 modules. Apply by 8 November 2026.
summary.ka: ხუთკვირიანი პრაქტიკული იურიდიული ინგლისურის კურსი თბილისში, TOLES/Cambridge Law Studio-ს პროგრამით — ხელშეკრულებები და კომერციული სამართალი 10 მოდულში. განაცხადის ვადაა 8 ნოემბერი, 2026.
summary.ar: دورة عملية في الإنجليزية القانونية لمدة خمسة أسابيع في تبليسي وفق منهج TOLES/Cambridge Law Studio، تغطي العقود والقانون التجاري في 10 وحدات. آخر موعد للتقديم 8 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
The TOLES Legal English Centre Georgia at the University of Georgia offers Illuminate Plus, a practical Legal English course for students and legal professionals. Based on the TOLES/Cambridge Law Studio curriculum, its 10 modules cover contract formation, commercial contract clauses, business liability, warranties, damages for breach of contract and the structure of commercial agreements.

The course suits learners with B1–B2 English, improves legal terminology and analysis of legal texts, and prepares for all three levels of the TOLES Legal English exam. It runs for five weeks (two 2.5-hour sessions per week, 25 hours in total) at UG in Tbilisi, led by lecturer Tsira Chorgoliani. The fee includes one year of access to the Illuminate Plus online platform, a TOLES/Cambridge Law Studio certificate and a UG certificate.

en: TOLES/Cambridge Law Studio curriculum and certificate
Prepares for all three TOLES Legal English exam levels
One year of online platform access included

eligibility.en: Law students and legal professionals with B1–B2 English.

en: Email your CV to toles_info@ug.edu.ge by 8 November 2026
Confirm your place and payment schedule with the centre
Attend the 10 sessions at UG, Tbilisi

costs.en: Fee: 900 GEL, payable in three instalments of 300 GEL; includes platform access and certificates.

score_reason: Recognised Legal English certificate, but paid and narrow audience.

org: National Bank of Georgia (FinEdu financial education platform)

name.en: Visit the National Bank of Georgia: Training for School Financial Education Clubs
name.ka: სტუმრად ეროვნულ ბანკში — შეხვედრები ფინანსური განათლების სასკოლო კლუბებისთვის
name.ar: زيارة البنك الوطني الجورجي: تدريب لنوادي التثقيف المالي المدرسية

deadline_note: Registration open from 21 October 2026 until places are filled (first come, first served); sessions held November–December 2026.

summary.en: Free two-hour educational sessions at the National Bank of Georgia headquarters in Tbilisi for school financial-education clubs (grades 8–12) on the theme 'From wishes to financial independence'. Club leaders register while places last.
summary.ka: უფასო ორსაათიანი საგანმანათლებლო შეხვედრები საქართველოს ეროვნული ბანკის სათავო ოფისში ფინანსური განათლების სასკოლო კლუბებისთვის (VIII–XII კლასები) თემაზე „სურვილებიდან ფინანსურ დამოუკიდებლობამდე“. კლუბის ხელმძღვანელი არეგისტრირებს ადგილების ამოწურვამდე.
summary.ar: جلسات تعليمية مجانية مدتها ساعتان في المقر الرئيسي للبنك الوطني الجورجي في تبليسي لنوادي التثقيف المالي المدرسية (الصفوف 8–12) بعنوان «من الرغبات إلى الاستقلال المالي». يسجّل قائد النادي حتى امتلاء الأماكن.

about.en:
FinEdu, the financial-education platform of the National Bank of Georgia (NBG), invites school financial-education clubs to information and training sessions at the NBG headquarters in Tbilisi. The project is designed for pupils in grades 8–12 and aims to strengthen interest in financial literacy and personal money-management skills.

Each two-hour session on the theme 'From wishes to financial independence' combines short theory, practical exercises, discussion and fun activities. Sessions are scheduled for November–December 2026. The club's leader (usually a teacher) registers the club through FinEdu's online form; places are limited and allocated in order of registration, and the form closes when full.

en: Visit the central bank of Georgia with your school club
Hands-on activities on budgeting and personal finance
Free; places allocated first come, first served

eligibility.en: School financial-education clubs in Georgia with pupils in grades 8–12; registration is done by the club leader. Sessions are in Georgian.

en: Ask your teacher or club leader to open the FinEdu announcement
The club leader completes the registration form linked on the page
Wait for FinEdu to confirm the session date
Attend the session at NBG headquarters in Tbilisi

score_reason: Free and accessible for school clubs, but short and club-based registration.

org: Georgian Tech Olympiads Hub (TBC Bank and Business and Technology University, BTU)

name.en: EGOI 2027 Georgia Team Selection (European Girls' Olympiad in Informatics)
name.ka: ევროპის გოგოების ოლიმპიადა ინფორმატიკაში (EGOI) 2027 — საქართველოს ნაკრების შესარჩევი
name.ar: اختيار منتخب جورجيا لأولمبياد الفتيات الأوروبي في المعلوماتية EGOI 2027

duration.en: Two 5-hour selection rounds in spring 2027, then a 20-day training camp
duration.ka: ორი 5-საათიანი შესარჩევი ტური 2027 წლის გაზაფხულზე, შემდეგ 20-დღიანი შეკრება
duration.ar: جولتا اختيار مدة كل منهما 5 ساعات في ربيع 2027، ثم معسكر تدريبي لمدة 20 يومًا

deadline_note: Hub page states registration runs 1–31 March each year via a Google Form published on TBC's site; 2027 dates follow this annual pattern.

summary.en: Georgia's national selection for the European Girls' Olympiad in Informatics: two algorithmic rounds at BTU in Tbilisi pick a team of four girls (plus two reserves) who get a 20-day training camp before EGOI. Registration runs 1–31 March 2027.
summary.ka: საქართველოს ნაკრების შერჩევა ევროპის გოგოების ოლიმპიადისთვის ინფორმატიკაში: BTU-ში ორი ალგორითმული ტურით ირჩევა 4 გოგონა (და 2 რეზერვისტი), რომლებიც ოლიმპიადამდე 20-დღიან შეკრებას გადიან. რეგისტრაცია 1–31 მარტი, 2027.
summary.ar: الاختيار الوطني الجورجي لأولمبياد الفتيات الأوروبي في المعلوماتية: جولتان خوارزميتان في جامعة BTU بتبليسي لاختيار فريق من 4 فتيات (واحتياطيتين) يخضعن لمعسكر تدريبي لمدة 20 يومًا قبل الأولمبياد. التسجيل من 1 إلى 31 مارس 2027.

about.en:
The Georgian Tech Olympiads Hub, a joint project of TBC Bank and Business and Technology University (BTU), runs Georgia's national selection for the European Girls' Olympiad in Informatics (EGOI). EGOI encourages girls into computer science: each country sends a team of four girls who solve hard algorithmic problems individually in two five-hour contest days.

The Georgian selection mirrors the international format: two rounds of three problems in five hours each, held on the BTU campus in Tbilisi. The four best girls form the national team (with two reserves) and attend a 20-day intensive training camp before travelling to EGOI; participation, training and team travel are organised by the Hub. Solid programming skills plus algorithms and data structures are required.

en: Path to an international olympiad for girls in programming
20-day pre-olympiad training camp for the selected team
Free selection rounds at BTU, Tbilisi

eligibility.en: Girls under 18 who are school students in Georgia; strong programming, algorithms and data-structures skills needed.

en: Watch the Georgian Tech Olympiads Hub page on TBC's website in late February 2027
Fill in the Google Form registration between 1 and 31 March 2027
Sit the two selection rounds at BTU
If selected, join the 20-day training camp and travel with the team to EGOI

costs.en: Free; team training and participation organised by the Hub (TBC Bank and BTU).

score_reason: Free route to an international olympiad with training; demanding and girls-only by design.

org: ROCO Academy (official GENIUS Olympiad representative in Georgia), hosted by The University of Georgia (UG)

name.ka: GENIUS ოლიმპიადის საქართველოს ეროვნული შესარჩევი ტური 2027

duration.en: Pre-registration by late January; national round in March 2027
duration.ka: წინასწარი რეგისტრაცია იანვრის ბოლომდე; ეროვნული ტური 2027 წლის მარტში
duration.ar: تسجيل مسبق حتى أواخر يناير؛ الجولة الوطنية في مارس 2027

deadline_note: UG's announcement for the last cycle gave a 25 January pre-registration deadline and a March national round; 2027 date assumed to follow the same annual pattern, confirm on UG/ROCO pages.

summary.en: Georgia's national selection for the GENIUS Olympiad, an international environment-themed competition: pupils in grades 8–12 compete in coding, AI, science, entrepreneurship or robotics at the University of Georgia, and winners represent Georgia at the Global Finals in Rochester, USA.
summary.ka: GENIUS ოლიმპიადის (გარემოსდაცვითი თემატიკის საერთაშორისო კონკურსი) საქართველოს ეროვნული შერჩევა: VIII–XII კლასის მოსწავლეები ასპარეზობენ კოდინგში, AI-ში, მეცნიერებაში, მეწარმეობასა და რობოტიკაში საქართველოს უნივერსიტეტში; გამარჯვებულები საქართველოს წარადგენენ გლობალურ ფინალზე როჩესტერში (აშშ).
summary.ar: التصفيات الوطنية الجورجية لأولمبياد GENIUS الدولي ذي الطابع البيئي: يتنافس طلاب الصفوف 8–12 في البرمجة أو الذكاء الاصطناعي أو العلوم أو ريادة الأعمال أو الروبوتات في جامعة جورجيا، ويمثل الفائزون جورجيا في النهائيات العالمية في روتشستر بالولايات المتحدة.

about.en:
The GENIUS Olympiad is an international competition that asks young people to understand global environmental challenges and design scientific, technological and creative solutions. ROCO Academy is the official GENIUS representative in Georgia and, with the University of Georgia (UG) as host, runs a nationwide internal selection round.

The selection is open to pupils in grades 8–12 in five categories: Coding, Artificial Intelligence, Science, Entrepreneurship and Robotics (one category per student). Students pre-register (in the last cycle the deadline was 25 January), selected participants compete in the national round at UG in Tbilisi in March, and winners represent Georgia at the GENIUS Olympiad Global Finals in Rochester, USA, in June.

en: Five categories: coding, AI, science, entrepreneurship, robotics
Winners go to the Global Finals in Rochester, USA
Hosted at the University of Georgia in Tbilisi

eligibility.en: School students in grades 8–12 in Georgia; one category per student.

en: Check UG's announcements and ROCO Academy channels from December 2026
Pre-register in one category before the January deadline (25 January in the last cycle)
Prepare your project or solution for the chosen category
Compete in the national selection round at UG in March 2027

costs.en: Selection round free per UG announcement; costs of the Global Finals trip are not stated.

score_reason: Real pathway to a US final across five categories; 2027 date inferred from the annual pattern.

org: Vladimir Komarovi Tbilisi Physics and Mathematics Public School No. 199

name.en: Komarovi Saturday School: Maths and Logic for Grades 3–6
name.ka: კომაროვის შაბათის სკოლა — მათემატიკა და ლოგიკა III–VI კლასებისთვის
name.ar: مدرسة كوماروفي يوم السبت: الرياضيات والمنطق للصفوف 3–6

duration.en: School year of 3 modules (12 weekly 3-hour lessons each)
duration.ar: عام دراسي من 3 وحدات (12 درسًا أسبوعيًا مدة كل منها 3 ساعات)

deadline_note: Year runs in three 3-month modules; new 2026-27 branches (Mukhiani, Isani) started 24–25 October 2026 and registration is via branch forms; ask the branch about joining at the next module.

summary.en: Weekly three-hour maths and logic classes for gifted pupils in grades 3–6, run by Georgia's leading physics-maths school in Tbilisi and over 20 regional towns. The year has three modules with tests and olympiads; strong results can lead to admission to Komarovi.
summary.ka: ყოველკვირეული სამსაათიანი მათემატიკისა და ლოგიკის მეცადინეობები III–VI კლასის ნიჭიერი მოსწავლეებისთვის — კომაროვის სკოლის პროგრამით თბილისსა და 20-ზე მეტ რეგიონულ ქალაქში. წელი 3 მოდულისგანაა, შემაჯამებელი წერებითა და ოლიმპიადებით.
summary.ar: دروس أسبوعية مدتها ثلاث ساعات في الرياضيات والمنطق للطلاب الموهوبين في الصفوف 3–6، تديرها أبرز مدرسة للفيزياء والرياضيات في جورجيا في تبليسي وأكثر من 20 مدينة إقليمية. يتكون العام من ثلاث وحدات مع اختبارات وأولمبيادات.

about.en:
Komarovi School (Tbilisi Physics and Mathematics Public School No. 199) has run its 'Saturday School' for about 20 years. It is a weekly maths and logic programme for pupils in grades 3–6 who enjoy mathematics: one three-hour lesson a week, groups of 17–20, specially compiled problem books given free to students, and game-based teaching for the youngest.

The school year is split into three modules of 12 lessons; each module ends with a summative test, and Saturday School pupils take part in the school's grade-5 and grade-6 maths olympiads. Besides the main campus (49 Vazha-Pshavela Ave), new Tbilisi branches opened in October 2026 at Prometheus school (Mukhiani, Saturdays) and SEU (Isani, Sundays), and the programme also runs in more than 20 regional towns including Batumi, Gori, Zugdidi, Telavi, Rustavi and Mtskheta. It is a respected early pathway to olympiad maths and to Komarovi's competitive entrance exam.

en: Olympiad-style maths and logic from a top Georgian physics-maths school
Branches across Tbilisi and 20+ regional towns
Free problem books, small groups, end-of-module tests and olympiads

eligibility.en: Pupils in grades 3–6 with an interest in mathematics; taught in Georgian.

en: Read the Saturday School pages on komarovi.edu.ge
Fill in the registration form of your branch (links in the October 2026 announcement) or contact the branch manager
Agree the group and payment with the branch
Attend weekly lessons; take the module-end tests

costs.en: New students: 600 GEL per module (12 lessons, 3 months); sibling discount (300 GEL per module for each additional child).

score_reason: High-quality, nationwide maths enrichment for young pupils; paid and module-based entry.

org: Caucasus University (School of Technology) with the Scientific Cyber Security Association

name.en: Cybersecurity and AI in Education: International Conference at Caucasus University (pupils can present)
name.ka: საერთაშორისო კონფერენცია „კიბერუსაფრთხოება და ხელოვნური ინტელექტი განათლებაში“ (კავკასიის უნივერსიტეტი)
name.ar: مؤتمر دولي «الأمن السيبراني والذكاء الاصطناعي في التعليم» في جامعة القوقاز (يمكن للتلاميذ تقديم عروض)

deadline_note: Conference on 7 November 2026; registration via the Google Form on the CU announcement (no separate closing date given, register before the event).

summary.en: A free hybrid conference in Tbilisi on cybersecurity, deepfakes, voice cloning, AI ethics and digital hygiene, where pupils in grades 5–12 can register as speakers or listeners. Speakers receive certificates and the title 'Digital Education and Safety Ambassador'.
summary.ka: უფასო ჰიბრიდული კონფერენცია თბილისში კიბერუსაფრთხოებაზე, დიპფეიკებზე, ხმის კლონირებაზე, AI ეთიკასა და ციფრულ ჰიგიენაზე; V–XII კლასის მოსწავლეებს შეუძლიათ დარეგისტრირდნენ მომხსენებლად ან მსმენელად. მომხსენებლები იღებენ სერტიფიკატს და „ციფრული განათლებისა და უსაფრთხოების ელჩის“ სტატუსს.
summary.ar: مؤتمر مجاني هجين في تبليسي حول الأمن السيبراني والتزييف العميق واستنساخ الصوت وأخلاقيات الذكاء الاصطناعي والنظافة الرقمية، يمكن لطلاب الصفوف 5–12 التسجيل فيه كمتحدثين أو مستمعين. يحصل المتحدثون على شهادات ولقب «سفير التعليم والأمان الرقمي».

about.en:
Caucasus University's School of Technology hosts an international hybrid conference, 'Cybersecurity and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Education', organised by the Scientific Cyber Security Association and Educational Technologies, with partners Sulakauri Publishing and the Georgian AI Association (GAIA). It takes place on 7 November 2026 from 10:30.

The programme includes an interactive panel on cybersecurity, deepfakes, voice cloning, AI ethics and digital hygiene, with experts answering participants' questions. School teachers and pupils in grades 5–12 can register as speakers and present their own topic, or attend as listeners in person or online. All attendees receive a participation certificate; teachers and pupils who present also receive the status of 'Digital Education and Safety Ambassador'. A good first conference-speaking experience for school students interested in tech.

en: Pupils in grades 5–12 can present their own talk
Certificates for all; 'Digital Education and Safety Ambassador' status for speakers
Hybrid: attend at Caucasus University in Tbilisi or online

eligibility.en: School pupils in grades 5–12, teachers and anyone interested; working language Georgian.

en: Open the event page on cu.edu.ge
Fill in the registration form and choose 'speaker' or 'listener'
If presenting, prepare a short talk on cybersecurity or AI in education
Receive the agenda by email a few days before 7 November and attend on site or online

score_reason: Free and open to school pupils as speakers, but one day and very near.

name.en: Volunteer with the Georgia Red Cross Society
name.ka: გახდი საქართველოს წითელი ჯვრის საზოგადოების მოხალისე
name.ar: تطوّع مع جمعية الصليب الأحمر الجورجي

grades: any (age rules set by the local branch)
deadline_note: Rolling volunteer registration via the 'Become a volunteer' section of redcross.ge.

summary.en: Join Georgia's national Red Cross society, which counts about 15,000 registered volunteers and 39 branches nationwide, helping with first aid, disaster preparedness, social day centres and public-health campaigns. Registration is open year-round.
summary.ka: შეუერთდი საქართველოს წითელი ჯვრის საზოგადოებას, რომელსაც ქვეყნის მასშტაბით დაახლოებით 15 000 რეგისტრირებული მოხალისე და 39 ფილიალი ჰყავს — პირველადი დახმარება, კატასტროფებისთვის მზადყოფნა, სოციალური დღის ცენტრები და ჯანდაცვის კამპანიები. რეგისტრაცია მთელი წლის განმავლობაშია ღია.
summary.ar: انضم إلى الجمعية الوطنية للصليب الأحمر في جورجيا التي تضم نحو 15,000 متطوع مسجل و39 فرعًا في أنحاء البلاد، للمساعدة في الإسعافات الأولية والاستعداد للكوارث ومراكز الرعاية النهارية وحملات الصحة العامة. التسجيل مفتوح طوال العام.

about.en:
The Georgia Red Cross Society is the country's national Red Cross society and part of the world's largest humanitarian network. It reports around 15,000 registered volunteers, 39 branches and 27 social day centres across Georgia, and runs projects on mass immunisation support, diabetes prevention in Kvemo Kartli and disaster management, with support from the IFRC, ICRC and partner national societies.

Volunteers help in their own town or region: supporting social day centres and older people, first-aid and health-awareness activities, emergency and disaster preparedness, and fundraising or community events. Many school and university students start through Red Cross youth clubs (some schools have their own clubs). Volunteering builds first-aid skills, teamwork and a strong record of community service for university applications.

en: Nationwide network: 39 branches, about 15,000 volunteers
First-aid training and humanitarian experience
Year-round registration; volunteer close to home

eligibility.en: Open to residents of Georgia; minimum age and tasks depend on the branch (minors usually need parental consent). Georgian is useful for most activities.

en: Open redcross.ge and go to 'Become a volunteer'
Complete the volunteer registration or contact the head office (+995 32 2 501 105, 71 Vazisubani St, Tbilisi)
Get referred to your local branch
Attend the induction and first-aid training, then join activities

score_reason: Always open and nationwide; general volunteering rather than a structured programme.

name.en: British Council Georgia: Secondary English Courses for Teens (11–17)
name.ka: ბრიტანეთის საბჭო საქართველოში — ინგლისურის კურსები მოზარდებისთვის (11–17 წელი)
name.ar: المجلس الثقافي البريطاني في جورجيا: دورات الإنجليزية للمراهقين (11–17 عامًا)

duration.en: Academic-year courses (classroom in Tbilisi or live online)
duration.ar: دورات على مدار العام الدراسي (في تبليسي أو عبر الإنترنت مباشرة)

deadline_note: Rolling enrolment; British Council says new academic-year registrations for ages 5–17 are open; book a free consultation.

summary.en: English courses for 11–17-year-olds at the British Council in Tbilisi or live online, alongside Cambridge exam preparation and grammar coaching. Enrolment is rolling, starting with a free consultation and level check.
summary.ka: ინგლისურის კურსები 11–17 წლის მოზარდებისთვის ბრიტანეთის საბჭოში, თბილისში ან ონლაინ, Cambridge-ის გამოცდებისთვის მომზადებითა და გრამატიკის კურსებით. რეგისტრაცია უწყვეტია — იწყება უფასო კონსულტაციით და დონის განსაზღვრით.
summary.ar: دورات إنجليزية لمن تتراوح أعمارهم بين 11 و17 عامًا في المجلس الثقافي البريطاني في تبليسي أو عبر الإنترنت، مع التحضير لامتحانات كامبريدج ودورات القواعد. التسجيل مستمر ويبدأ باستشارة مجانية وتحديد المستوى.

about.en:
The British Council in Georgia runs English courses for children and teenagers at its Tbilisi teaching centre and online. The Secondary English course (11–17 years) builds communication, confidence and academic English; related options include a Grammar and Vocabulary Coach, Cambridge English exam preparation for teens and live online Secondary English classes.

Courses follow the school academic year and are taught by British Council teachers. Families start by booking a free consultation, where an adviser checks the learner's level and recommends a course; registration is then done online in four steps. A strong option for students preparing for Cambridge exams, IELTS later on, or study abroad.

en: Taught by British Council teachers in Tbilisi or live online
Cambridge exam preparation track for teens
Free consultation and level check before enrolling

eligibility.en: Learners aged 11–17; level assessed at consultation.

en: Visit the British Council Georgia 'English courses for kids and teens' page
Book a free consultation
Take the level check and choose a course and schedule
Register online and pay the course fee

costs.en: Paid; fees depend on course and are given on the course pages or at consultation.

score_reason: Reliable and always open, but a paid commercial course.

name.en: British Council Georgia: IELTS Preparation Course for Young Adults
name.ka: ბრიტანეთის საბჭო საქართველოში — IELTS-ისთვის მოსამზადებელი კურსი ახალგაზრდებისთვის
name.ar: المجلس الثقافي البريطاني في جورجيا: دورة التحضير لاختبار IELTS للشباب

duration.en: Short course; several intakes a year
duration.ar: دورة قصيرة؛ عدة دفعات في السنة

deadline_note: Rolling intakes; register through the British Council Georgia course registration page.

summary.en: An IELTS preparation course at the British Council in Tbilisi that builds familiarity with the exam format and the skills needed for a target score, useful for university applications abroad. Intakes run through the year.
summary.ka: IELTS-ისთვის მოსამზადებელი კურსი ბრიტანეთის საბჭოში, თბილისში — გამოცდის ფორმატისა და საჭირო უნარების დაუფლება სასურველი ქულისთვის, საზღვარგარეთ სწავლის მსურველთათვის. ნაკადები მთელი წლის განმავლობაშია.
summary.ar: دورة تحضير لاختبار IELTS في المجلس الثقافي البريطاني في تبليسي، تعرّف بصيغة الاختبار وتطوّر المهارات اللازمة للدرجة المطلوبة، وهي مفيدة للتقديم إلى الجامعات في الخارج. الدفعات متاحة طوال العام.

about.en:
The British Council, which co-owns the IELTS test, offers IELTS preparation courses for young adults at its teaching centre in Tbilisi. The course improves familiarity with the format and content of IELTS Academic and General Training and trains the four skills (listening, reading, writing, speaking) with exam strategies and practice.

It suits final-year school students and university students who need a specific score for admission or scholarships abroad. Candidates can also take a free IELTS familiarisation (practice) test online and book the real exam with the British Council in Georgia.

en: Taught by the organisation that co-owns IELTS
Exam strategies for all four skills
Can be combined with IELTS registration in Tbilisi

eligibility.en: Young adults (typically 16+) with at least intermediate English.

en: Open the British Council Georgia English courses page
Book a free consultation or check the IELTS preparation course page
Register online for the next intake and pay the fee

costs.en: Paid; course fee published on the course page or given at consultation (the IELTS exam fee is separate).

score_reason: Useful for study-abroad applicants, but paid and generic.

name.en: Goethe-Institut Georgia: German Courses for Children and Teens (8–16)
name.ka: გოეთეს ინსტიტუტი საქართველოში — გერმანული ენის კურსები ბავშვებისა და მოზარდებისთვის (8–16 წელი)
name.ar: معهد غوته في جورجيا: دورات اللغة الألمانية للأطفال والمراهقين (8–16 عامًا)

deadline_note: Rolling enrolment by course start; free placement test available; contact deutschkurse-tbilissi@goethe.de.

summary.en: German courses for learners aged 8–16 at the Goethe-Institut in Tbilisi, with age-appropriate, play-oriented content and a free placement test. A first step towards Goethe exams, German schools and study in Germany.
summary.ka: გერმანული ენის კურსები 8–16 წლის მოსწავლეებისთვის თბილისის გოეთეს ინსტიტუტში — ასაკის შესაბამისი, თამაშზე ორიენტირებული შინაარსით და უფასო დონის ტესტით. პირველი ნაბიჯი გოეთეს გამოცდებისა და გერმანიაში სწავლისკენ.
summary.ar: دورات اللغة الألمانية للمتعلمين من 8 إلى 16 عامًا في معهد غوته في تبليسي، بمحتوى مناسب للعمر قائم على اللعب واختبار تحديد مستوى مجاني. خطوة أولى نحو امتحانات غوته والدراسة في ألمانيا.

about.en:
The Goethe-Institut Georgien in Tbilisi (Sandukeli St 16) offers German courses for children and young people aged 8–16, with age-appropriate topics and play-oriented teaching. Lessons follow the CEFR levels (A1 onwards) and take place 2–3 times a week in the classroom and via Zoom.

Learners who already know some German can take a free placement test to find the right level. The courses prepare young learners for Goethe-Institut exams (Fit in Deutsch and the Goethe-Zertifikat), which are useful for German partner schools, youth exchanges and later study in Germany.

en: Official Goethe-Institut teaching in Tbilisi
Free placement test
Pathway to Goethe exams and study in Germany
Open the Goethe-Institut Georgia German courses page
Take the free placement test if you already know some German
Choose a course for children and young people and enrol via 'Contact and enrolment'
Pay the course fee before the course starts

costs.en: Paid; fees per course level are listed by the Goethe-Institut Georgien.

score_reason: Reliable, always available language course; paid.

org: Startupbootcamp Georgia (Rainmaking group), funded by Georgia's Innovation and Technology Agency (GITA)

name.en: Startupbootcamp Georgia: Dare to Start 2027 (Founder-Market Fit Programme)
name.ka: Startupbootcamp Georgia — Dare to Start 2027 (იდეის ვალიდაციის პროგრამა)
name.ar: Startupbootcamp جورجيا: برنامج Dare to Start 2027 (ملاءمة المؤسس والسوق)

deadline_note: Application deadline 27 November 2026 on the programme page; decisions the week of 7 December 2026.

summary.en: A free two-month hybrid programme in Georgia for about 40 founders with an idea: validate the problem, interview customers and test whether the solution is worth building. Apply by 27 November 2026.
summary.ka: უფასო ორთვიანი ჰიბრიდული პროგრამა საქართველოში დაახლოებით 40 დამფუძნებლისთვის, ვისაც იდეა აქვს: პრობლემის ვალიდაცია, მომხმარებელთან ინტერვიუები და გადაწყვეტის შემოწმება. განაცხადის ვადა 27 ნოემბერი, 2026.
summary.ar: برنامج هجين مجاني لمدة شهرين في جورجيا لنحو 40 مؤسسًا لديهم فكرة: التحقق من المشكلة ومقابلة العملاء واختبار جدوى الحل قبل بنائه. التقديم حتى 27 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
Startupbootcamp Georgia is a GITA-funded accelerator run by the Rainmaking group, adapting Startupbootcamp's global playbooks, mentors and investor networks to founders building from Georgia. 'Dare to Start' is its first stage, the Founder-Market Fit Programme, for people who have an idea or a problem worth exploring.

Over two months (12 January – 2 March 2027, hybrid), about 40 solo founders or teams define the problem and customer segment, research the market, and use customer discovery to test whether their solution direction is worth building. Applications are scored on founder qualities, problem clarity, market potential, execution potential and programme fit. Graduates can move on to 'Dare to Build' (MVP stage, GEL 50,000 grant) and 'Dare to Grow' (GEL 150,000 grant). A strong first step for student and young founders.

en: Free, structured idea-validation programme with Startupbootcamp mentors
Path to later GITA-funded stages with GEL 50,000–150,000 non-dilutive grants
Hybrid format; about 40 founders per cohort

eligibility.en: Tech-enabled startups in any sector; the company must be registered in Georgia before joining (founders of any nationality can register a Georgian company). Previous GITA grant recipients who received more than GEL 100,000 are not eligible; the same founders may reapply only with a different company. English and Georgian used.

en: Read the Dare to Start page and use the online stage finder if unsure
Submit the application form (tally.so) by 27 November 2026
Make sure your company can be registered in Georgia before the programme starts
Hear back the week of 7 December 2026; programme starts 12 January 2027

score_reason: Free, open now with a near deadline, backed by GITA and a global accelerator brand.

org: Startupbootcamp Georgia (Rainmaking group), funded by Georgia's Innovation and Technology Agency (GITA)

name.en: Startupbootcamp Georgia: Dare to Build 2027 (MVP Programme, GEL 50,000 grant)
name.ka: Startupbootcamp Georgia — Dare to Build 2027 (MVP პროგრამა, 50 000 ლარის გრანტი)
name.ar: Startupbootcamp جورجيا: برنامج Dare to Build 2027 (منتج أولي، منحة 50,000 لاري)

deadline_note: Application deadline 31 January 2027 on the programme page; decisions the week of 8 March 2027.

summary.en: A four-month hybrid accelerator in Georgia where about 20 startups design, build and test an MVP with real customers, with a GEL 50,000 non-dilutive grant from GITA. Apply by 31 January 2027.
summary.ka: ოთხთვიანი ჰიბრიდული აქსელერატორი საქართველოში, სადაც დაახლოებით 20 სტარტაპი ქმნის და ტესტავს MVP-ს რეალურ მომხმარებლებთან, GITA-ს 50 000 ლარის გრანტით (წილის გარეშე). განაცხადის ვადა 31 იანვარი, 2027.
summary.ar: مسرّع هجين لمدة أربعة أشهر في جورجيا يصمم فيه نحو 20 شركة ناشئة منتجًا أوليًا ويختبرونه مع عملاء حقيقيين، مع منحة غير مستردة قدرها 50,000 لاري من GITA. التقديم حتى 31 يناير 2027.

about.en:
'Dare to Build' is the MVP stage of Startupbootcamp Georgia, the GITA-funded accelerator delivered by the Rainmaking group. It is for founders who have validated a problem and are ready to turn that insight into a working product.

From 18 March to 2 July 2027, about 20 founders or teams create an MVP roadmap, build and test the product with users, and strengthen financial, legal, branding and pitching foundations. Each selected startup receives a GEL 50,000 grant from GITA and no equity is taken. Selection looks at the team's commitment, evidence of customer discovery, solution scope, early business-model thinking and openness to mentorship.

en: GEL 50,000 non-dilutive grant from GITA
Mentoring from Startupbootcamp's global network
Build and test an MVP with real customers

eligibility.en: Tech-enabled startups in any sector; the company must be registered in Georgia before joining (founders of any nationality can register a Georgian company). Previous GITA grant recipients who received more than GEL 100,000 are not eligible; the same founders may reapply only with a different company. English and Georgian used.

en: Read the Dare to Build page
Prepare evidence of customer discovery and problem validation
Submit the application form by 31 January 2027
Hear back the week of 8 March 2027

costs.en: Free to join; GEL 50,000 grant per startup; no equity taken.

about.en:
'Dare to Grow' is the most advanced stage of Startupbootcamp Georgia, funded by GITA and delivered by the Rainmaking group. It is for startups with a product or MVP that are ready to find customers, enter markets and prepare for investment.

From 12 July to 16 December 2027, 10 startups optimise their MVP and market-entry approach, build customer acquisition, sales and retention systems, assess international expansion and strengthen fundraising materials before pitching to investors. Each receives a GEL 150,000 grant from GITA with no equity taken. Selection weighs team strength, traction, market opportunity, product readiness, business model and growth ambition.

eligibility.en: Tech-enabled startups in any sector; the company must be registered in Georgia before joining (founders of any nationality can register a Georgian company). Previous GITA grant recipients who received more than GEL 100,000 are not eligible; the same founders may reapply only with a different company. English and Georgian used.

about.en:
'TSU Envoy' (TSU Despani) is a project of TSU's Children's University that has run for 13 seasons. Students at any level (bachelor's, master's, PhD, vocational or the 60-credit teacher programme) return to their own former school and present TSU's study programmes and student life to senior pupils, helping them choose a university and profession.

Before visiting schools, registered envoys complete training in presentation skills (in the 2026 season, 26 January – 13 February). The project promotes volunteering and non-formal education and is supported by the Ministry of Education, Science and Youth. Each participant receives a certificate of participation, which can be used in TSU scholarship competitions. Contact: tsuenvoy@tsu.ge.

en: Presentation-skills training before school visits
Certificate usable in scholarship competitions
Give back to your own school and mentor younger pupils

eligibility.en: Students of Ivane Javakhishvili Tbilisi State University at any level; teaching in Georgian.

about.en:
Ilia State University's International Summer School 'Black Sea and Caucasus: Diversity, Conflicts and Networks' brings students from around the world to its main campus in Tbilisi for four weeks. The course examines the region's cultural, political and economic dimensions (Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Georgia, Moldova, Türkiye and Ukraine), including recent conflicts, cooperation patterns, security and development, taught by Ilia faculty with guest speakers such as Harvard's Davis Center and the U.S. Embassy in Tbilisi. Participants also study Georgian, Ukrainian or Russian.

The package includes tuition, serviced accommodation, insurance, airport transfer, a welcome pack, cultural activities and field trips (Kazbegi, Kakheti, Batumi, Mtskheta and Gori), most meals and certificates. In 2026 it ran 29 June – 26 July with an early-bird deadline of 1 April and a main deadline of 1 May; the 2027 edition is expected to follow the same calendar. Excellent for international relations, history and regional-studies students who want a first-hand look at the Caucasus.
